mapper.select: SELECT id AS staff_id, merchant_id, store_id, employment_status, service_enabled FROM merchant_staff WHERE store_id = #{storeId} ORDER BY id

SELECT m.id AS merchant_id, m.owner_user_id, m.merchant_name, m.status AS merchant_status, s.id AS store_id, s.store_name, s.address, s.longitude, s.latitude, s.phone, s.status AS store_status, s.version AS store_version FROM merchant_store s INNER JOIN merchant m ON m.id = s.merchant_id WHERE s.id = #{storeId} AND m.owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}

SELECT m.id AS merchant_id, m.owner_user_id, m.merchant_name, m.status AS merchant_status, s.id AS store_id, s.store_name, s.address, s.longitude, s.latitude, s.phone, s.status AS store_status, s.version AS store_version FROM merchant_store s INNER JOIN merchant m ON m.id = s.merchant_id WHERE m.owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} ORDER BY m.id ASC, s.id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM merchant_store s INNER JOIN merchant m ON m.id = s.merchant_id WHERE m.owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}

SELECT m.id AS merchant_id, m.owner_user_id, m.status AS merchant_status, s.id AS store_id, s.status AS store_status FROM merchant m INNER JOIN merchant_store s ON s.merchant_id = m.id WHERE m.id = #{merchantId} AND s.id = #{storeId}

SELECT m.id AS merchant_id, m.owner_user_id, m.status AS merchant_status, s.id AS store_id, s.status AS store_status, st.id AS staff_id, st.staff_name, st.phone, st.employment_status, st.service_enabled, st.version AS staff_version FROM merchant_staff st INNER JOIN merchant_store s ON s.id = st.store_id AND s.merchant_id = st.merchant_id INNER JOIN merchant m ON m.id = st.merchant_id WHERE m.id = #{merchantId} AND s.id = #{storeId} AND st.id = #{staffId} AND m.owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}

SELECT m.id AS merchant_id, m.merchant_name, m.status AS merchant_status, s.id AS store_id, s.store_name, s.address, s.longitude, s.latitude, s.phone, s.status AS store_status, p.city_code AS city_code FROM merchant_store s INNER JOIN merchant m ON m.id = s.merchant_id LEFT JOIN merchant_profile_compat p ON p.merchant_id = m.id ORDER BY m.id ASC, s.id ASC

SELECT m.id AS merchant_id, m.merchant_name, m.status AS merchant_status, s.id AS store_id, s.store_name, s.address, s.longitude, s.latitude, s.phone, s.status AS store_status, p.city_code AS city_code FROM merchant_store s INNER JOIN merchant m ON m.id = s.merchant_id LEFT JOIN merchant_profile_compat p ON p.merchant_id = m.id WHERE s.id = #{storeId}
